note: Sweetwater County's GIS viewers (maps.terragis.net, greenwoodmap) list ownership, roads, tax class and water layers but no zoning layer, and their REST services were not reachable. The county's zoning is in a computer-generated map declared official in the 2015 Zoning Resolution, with no queryable service found. Rock Springs publishes its official zoning map only as a PDF (4/3/2024). Green River offers a zoning map PDF and a paid GIS CD. No ArcGIS REST zoning districts layer for the county or its cities was found in ArcGIS Online or the Wyoming GeoHub.
